annotations.title: CIDR calculator: calculate the address range, size and netmask of a CIDR block

description: Details of an IPv4 network in CIDR notation: network and broadcast address, first and last usable host, netmask, number of addresses, and whether a given IP falls inside. Use for firewall rules and allowlists. Example: cidr=192.168.1.0/24. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
